title: Accountant cum Administrator
description:
**Accountant cum Admin Executive**

**Company:** Inniti Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Description

Inniti Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a responsible and organized **Accountant cum Admin Executive** who can manage day\-to\-day accounting activities along with general office administration and coordination.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle daily accounting entries, vouchers, ledgers and bookkeeping.
* Manage sales/purchase invoices, receipts, payments and expenses.
* Handle **GST, TDS, bank reconciliation and basic statutory compliance**.
* Track customer outstanding payments and vendor payments.
* Maintain accounts receivable and payable records.
* Coordinate with CA/auditors for taxation, compliance and accounting requirements.
* Maintain employee attendance, leave and basic HR/admin records.
* Manage office documentation, filing and record keeping.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for routine office requirements.
* Handle general office administration and internal coordination.
* Assist management with reports, documentation and other administrative activities.

Candidate Profile

* **B.Com / M.Com** or equivalent qualification preferred.
* **1–3 years of relevant experience** in Accounts and/or Administration.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Organized, detail\-oriented and able to handle multiple responsibilities.
* **Freshers with strong accounting knowledge may also be considered.**

Compensation \& Work Details

* **Full\-time, office\-based position**
* Salary based on experience, skills and current compensation.
* Professional work environment with opportunities to learn and grow.

Apply Now

Interested candidates can send their updated CV to:

**innitierp.reema@gmail.com**

**Inniti Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**

Pay: ₹8,592\.56 \- ₹20,743\.88 per month

Work Location: In person
